title: UserLinkFetch::Loading has no RequestId; getUserLink answer matched by purpose (free: None)
trigger: fetch_own_user_link sets Loading then sends; accept_link/fail_link set Ready/Failed for any answer whose purpose is GetUserLink { free: None }
effect: no bug today; a stale answer from an earlier box lands in a later one's Loading
fix: UserLinkFetch::Loading(RequestId) compared in accept_link/fail_link

title: PollVotersFetch::Loading holds no RequestId; the answer is matched by purpose key
trigger: fetch_poll_voters_page inserts Loading for (chat, message, option); the answer and error arms find the entry by the purpose's chat/message/option/offset, and a load-more page is tracked only through requests.has_purpose_for_chat
effect: no bug today: nothing ties the answer to the request that asked, so a reload that overwrites Loaded with Loading (offset 0) and an older page answer with the same key both land in the new stage
fix: Loading { request: RequestId } and a MorePage-style Idle/Loading(RequestId) inside Loaded, compared on answer

title: proxy ping stage is split between pings (Checking) and a side map of request ids
trigger: Ping a list entry, then edit or remove it (edit_proxy_by / remove_proxy_by drop pings[slot] but not proxy_ping_requests[slot])
effect: no bug today: take_awaited_ping needs both maps to agree before it lands an answer, but the two have to be changed together by hand and a lost answer leaves an orphan request id
fix: PingStatus::Checking(RequestId) in pings; delete proxy_ping_requests (the way LinkCheck::Checking(RequestId) already works)

title: quick reply in-flight maps are pruned by the starter, and message loads carry no request
trigger: send_quick_reply_request retains `changing` entries by requests.get(..).is_some() and send_quick_reply does the same for `sending`; ensure_quick_reply_messages inserts Fetch::Loading { request: None } after the send
effect: no bug today: dedupe depends on payload strings and on the request table, not on the answer leaving the stage; the messages load is matched to its answer by purpose.shortcut_id
fix: clear the entry in the answer/error arm by RequestId and store the RequestId in Fetch::Loading

title: The refetch mark after a set edit is consumed even when the installed-list request that satisfies it is already in flight
trigger: Edit a set (rename, add, delete) while a getInstalledStickerSets or emoji-sets request sent before the edit finished is still out
effect: take_sticker_set_refetch clears creator_refetch_sets, has_purpose skips the send, and the in-flight answer may hold the pre-edit list, so the 'Add to ... Set' menus and panel badge stay stale until the next refresh
fix: Keep the mark until a request sent after the edit is out (Fetch::Outdated style)

title: sync_sticker_set_view re-sends getStickerSet from every poll tick after a refused send
trigger: After a set edit, with the send refused (offline path)
effect: sticker_set_box_tick calls it each poll; refresh_needed stays true until a send goes out, so each poll rebuilds a request and returns Err. Wasted work only, no redraw loop
fix: Fail the refresh (a stage the box draws) or wait for the path to become active

title: Sticker batch progress is four fields kept in step by hand
trigger: manage_sticker_sets writes batch_total, batch_completed, batch_failed, batch_pending together; finish_sticker_batch_item (session_stickers.rs:41-49) edits pending and one of the counters; nothing clears them when the batch ends or the account goes
effect: A finished batch keeps total/completed/failed from the last run; a new run resets them field by field, and total can disagree with pending+completed+failed
fix: StickerBatch { Idle, Running { total, pending: Vec<i64>, completed, failed } } in one field

title: Stale marks for recent/favorite/trending stickers are bools beside Fetch lists that have an Outdated stage
trigger: updateRecentStickers/FavoriteStickers/TrendingStickerSets set recent_stale/favorites_stale/trending_stale (stickers/apply.rs:99-107); refresh_stale_panels clears them by hand after the send, and masks them with &= when the panel is closed
effect: StickerLists::{recent,favorites,trending} are Fetch<()> with Outdated, yet a second bool says the same thing; reaction_options_stale and gifs.stale are the same shape. The mark and the Fetch stage can disagree (a Fetch::Loading list with the flag set)
fix: Fetch::outdate() on lists.recent/favorites/trending (and a MessageReactionsState::Outdated), no separate bool

title: Sticker panel browse mode is reset field by field at several call sites
trigger: select_sticker_tab (231-233) clears set, selected_set_id and stickers; search_sticker_picker (289-296) clears selected_set_id, set, search_offset, search_has_more, searched, found_sets, found_stickers; search_sticker_category (sticker_categories.rs:56-59) repeats the search half; session_stickers.rs:227 and session_apply_ok.rs:335 clear selected_set_id again
effect: A new reset site that misses one field leaves a selected set, a search cursor or found list from the previous mode (a stale has_more with an empty list asks for a page of the wrong query)
fix: One StickerBrowse enum (Installed{selected,set} | Search{query,offset,has_more,sets,stickers} | Category{..}) replaced whole on a mode change

title: Attached-stickers lookup keeps its stage in four places: attached_request, attached_answer (Option<Option<i64>>), a sticker_set_view with set_id 0 as a sentinel, and the loading stage
trigger: fetch_attached_sticker_sets writes attached_answer=None, sticker_set_view=Some(loading(0)), attached_request=Some(id); open_attached_sticker_set finds 'its' box by view.set_id == 0 && stage == Loading
effect: The waiting box is recognised by a magic id rather than by the request; the view is written over whatever set box was held; the answer slot is a nested Option that nothing clears if the box closes before the answer (it is taken on the next open only)
fix: StickerSetViewStage::AttachedLookup { request } inside the view, answered by RequestId; no separate slots

title: reaction_options_stale refetch resets message_reaction_options to Idle before fetch_message_reactions; a refused send leaves the picker Idle with the stale mark then cleared next poll (target() is None)
trigger: updateActiveEmojiReactions while a reaction picker is open and the send is refused (offline)
effect: Open picker never gets its options until closed and reopened
fix: keep MessageReactionsState::Loading/Outdated through the send and fail it on Err

title: The saved-GIF stale mark is cleared before the refetch is sent
trigger: updateSavedAnimations marks the panel stale; maybe_refresh_saved_animations sets stale=false right after saved_asked, the send fails; saved_failed counts the list as loaded
effect: The GIF list stays out of date and no refetch is asked until the panel is reopened
fix: Outdated stays on saved until the answer lands

title: The first public-forwards page send is dropped with let _ =, leaving ForwardsPage::NotAsked drawn as 'No public shares yet'
trigger: Open the story Statistics panel; getStoryStatistics goes out but the first getStoryPublicForwards send fails
effect: forwards_page stays NotAsked with an empty next offset: the panel shows 'No public shares yet', and story_forwards_more never asks (it needs a non-empty offset), so the list is never loaded or retried
fix: Mark ForwardsPage::Failed when the first page cannot be sent so the panel shows the error and a scroll retries

title: addOffer has no in-flight guard, unlike approve and decline
trigger: Submit the same Edit Price/Add Offer twice before the first answer: send_suggested only dedupes Approve and Decline (busy)
effect: Two offer messages (each with a Stars/TON price) go to the channel's direct-messages chat
fix: Dedupe AddOffer per (chat, message) the way suggested_post_busy does for approve/decline, or hold the RequestId in the offer box

title: claimed_owner is set before account_data::claim runs and kept when the owner file cannot be written
trigger: account signs in on a full or read-only disk (or the app root has no parent)
effect: claim_account_owner (connect/core/pumps.rs:48-71) writes Some(me) first, then logs owner_error and never retries in this process, so the folder has no owner file until a later start; its own doc says the next start then cannot tell whose the folder is (a Fresh sign-in with leftovers drops them)
fix: enum OwnerClaim { Unclaimed, Claimed(i64), Unsaved(i64) } that retries Unsaved on the next ingest, or set the marker only when owner_error is None

title: A failed send in maybe_decline_busy_calls drops the rest of the drained queues
trigger: created_call_discards or busy_decline_queue hold more than one entry and a discardCall send fails (client closing)
effect: both queues are taken whole with mem::take and the loop returns on the first error, so the remaining calls are never discarded or declined and nothing retries them; the caller keeps ringing
fix: drain one entry at a time (pop_front) and put back the entry and the rest on error, as maybe_finish_leave_deletes does

title: CallPrivacyAsks stage is only written by driver methods nothing in production calls
trigger: fetch_call_privacy and set_call_privacy have no non-test callers; the UI loads and sets the rules through fetch_privacy_rules / PrivacySettingKey
effect: calls.privacy_asks never leaves Idle in a real session, so privacy_loading()/privacy_error() are dead, and privacy_allow_calls / privacy_p2p are a second copy of the privacy rule detail (written optimistically by set_call_privacy, set by session_privacy_data and settings apply)
fix: delete the dead driver methods and the duplicate fields, read the call rules from the privacy rules store

title: accept_call can send a second acceptCall and answer_failed is matched by call id, not request
trigger: Click Accept twice (or accept while the first acceptCall is in flight) on a Pending incoming call
effect: accept_call only requires CallState::Pending, which stays Pending after the first send (CallProgress::Answered); a second acceptCall goes out. The second answer's error calls progress.answer_failed(call_id) which resets Answered to Idle by call id, so the call is treated as ringing again (and not as answered at close) while the first accept may still land
fix: refuse accept_call while progress is Answered{call_id}, and carry the accept RequestId in Answered so only its own answer clears it

title: createPrivateChat is guarded and answered by purpose, for all users at once
trigger: Click a user button / Saved Messages while another createPrivateChat is in flight, or two keyboard-user buttons quickly
effect: has_purpose(CreatePrivateChat) returns Ok(None) with no feedback, so the second click does nothing; the answer opens whichever chat answers (created_chat matched on purpose in ingest), not the user asked for
fix: key the guard and the open-on-answer by the user id carried in the pending request

title: request_logout has no re-entry guard while a logOut is in flight
trigger: Confirm Log out twice (or from two surfaces) before TDLib leaves Ready
effect: auth stays Ready, so a second logOut is sent; logout_sent again settles the account's requests, bumps the generation and replaces auth_state.logout_request, so the first answer no longer matches
fix: refuse request_logout unless shutdown is Running and logout_request is None, or make logout a stage of ShutdownPhase

title: load_more_group_call_participants has no in-flight guard and no stage: every click on 'Show more' sends another loadGroupCallParticipants; its error arm is ignored
trigger: Click 'Show more' repeatedly in a call with 100+ participants, or while offline
effect: duplicate paging requests, no spinner or error, button gives no feedback
fix: a Paging stage on the call (Idle / Loading(RequestId) / Failed) checked before sending, matched by RequestId

title: baseline: ActiveGroupCall::loaded_all_participants (also read in conference.rs:349 and ParsedGroupCall::loaded_all_participants) is still a stage-named bool; it is in implicit-state-allow.txt as TDLib's own report
trigger: n/a (no bug today)
effect: stays on the register as the allowed mirror of groupCall.loaded_all_participants; load_more has no paging stage beside it (see c3-019)
fix: keep as mirrored TDLib fact; put the paging stage (Idle/Loading/Failed) in its own value

title: A conference join is held in three places kept in step by hand: Session::calls::pending_conference, ConnectDriver::conference_crypto (Joining/Call key) and the engine instance under PENDING_CONFERENCE_KEY with its group offer
trigger: Accept a conference invitation, then the answer errors, the offer fails or the account switches
effect: abandon_conference_join and note_conference_answer each clear a different subset (Session pending vs driver crypto vs engine/offer); a missed one leaves a provisional engine instance or a bound crypto behind
fix: one ConferenceJoin value owned by the driver (request, key, crypto, offer) replaced whole; the Session keeps only what the UI reads

title: ActiveGroupCall::screen_share_paused (bool) is a substate of GroupScreenShare::Sharing, reset by hand at five sites (controls.rs:56, call_screen.rs:561/647/691, screen_chooser.rs:596) and by the pause error arm; GroupScreenShare::Starting { answer: String } uses an empty string as 'answer not arrived'
trigger: Share the screen, hide the shared window (paused = true), stop the share or fail the start
effect: paused can stay true while screen_share is Off/Starting if one reset site is missed; the tile then shows a paused share that is not there; empty String doubles as 'no answer'
fix: GroupScreenShare::Sharing { paused: bool } (or Paused), Starting { request: RequestId, answer: Option<String> }, and Failed(String) in place of screen_share_error

title: forget_all_group_offers takes the waiting requests but leaves the stages that wait for them
trigger: set_call_engine (connect/calls/mod.rs:56) runs while a rejoin, screen-share start or conference join is waiting for its payload
effect: GroupCallRejoin stays InFlight{request} for a request that is gone (the auto rejoin never restarts an in-flight one, only the manual Rejoin does), screen_share stays Starting and calls.pending_conference stays pending with no request; finish_offer's undo_offer path is the one that puts these back and is skipped
fix: Drain group_offers through finish_offer with an Unavailable payload (fail_offer/undo_offer) instead of dropping the map

title: RtmpStage::FetchFailed is a stage whose only exit is the UI writing calls.rtmp_start = None from elsewhere
trigger: getVideoChatRtmpUrl fails; the stage becomes FetchFailed and waits for ui/dialogs/rtmp_stream.rs:461 to drop the whole process by hand; begin_rtmp_start for the same chat returns Ok early while the stale process is there, so no retry is sent
effect: If the UI upkeep does not run (box closed in another window, lock) the dead process stays and a second Stream with... for that chat opens a box that never gets a URL until close_rtmp_start runs
fix: begin_rtmp_start treats FetchFailed as absent and starts a new Fetching; the failure toast is taken once and the stage owner removes itself on the answer

title: Boost box answers (getAvailableChatBoostSlots, boostChat) are matched by purpose and chat id, not by a RequestId held in BoostWork
trigger: Press Reassign (boostChat out, phase Working(Boosting)), close the box, reopen it for the same chat and press Boost (phase Working(Slots)); the old boostChat answer or error lands first
effect: state/domains/groups/apply.rs:295 and error.rs:607 replace whatever phase the new box is in with Main (note 'boosts are reassigned' or 'Could not boost'); the slots answer then finds no Working(Slots) and is dropped, so the press does nothing and the box shows the old request's note
fix: BoostWork::{Slots{request}, SlotsReady, Boosting{request, reassign}}; an answer or error counts only for the request in the phase

title: refresh_moved_boost_statuses drops the stale mark whether or not the refetch was sent
trigger: A channel's boost level moves while a getChatBoostStatus for it is already in flight (or the send fails): take_moved_boost_chats clears the cache and boost_level_moved, fetch_chat_boost_status returns Ok(None) for the in-flight request and the result is ignored
effect: The older answer lands and is cached as current; the new level is not asked again until the box is reopened
fix: Keep the chat marked until a request sent after the move has answered (Fetch with a stale variant)
